root_cause.summary: The Currency service container has exited, causing it to be unavailable. Frontend and Checkout services report errors when they attempt to call CurrencyService, leading to elevated error rates on frontend.

evidence.why_it_matters: Currency service not reporting metrics, marked DOWN.
Container health shows currency container NOT_RUNNING (exited).

evidence.exception: name resolver error: produced zero addresses
evidence.why_it_matters: Checkout trace fails at CurrencyService/Convert, indicating calls to currency fail.
Frontend trace fails at CurrencyService/GetSupportedCurrencies, confirming downstream errors.

proposed_action.reason: Currency service container is exited; restarting will bring it back online and stop downstream errors.

calibration_notes: confidence capped from 0.86 to 0.70: only 1 evidence kind(s) name currency
confidence lowered from 0.70 to 0.60: the reviewer disputed this diagnosis

timeline.event: Alert received: Error rate elevated on frontend

prevention: Implement health checks and auto-restart for the currency service to avoid manual downtime.
